# The optional SDK is built explicitly: no network during project configuration.
set(FVM_FFMPEG_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Static FFmpeg 6.1 SDK prefix (see external/ffmpeg/README.md)")
set(FVM_FFMPEG_SYSTEM_LIBRARIES "" CACHE STRING "Additional target libraries required by the supplied static FFmpeg SDK")
if(NOT EXISTS "${FVM_FFMPEG_ROOT}/include/libavcodec/avcodec.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "MEDIA requires a static FFmpeg 6.1 SDK: set FVM_FFMPEG_ROOT; see external/ffmpeg/README.md")
endif()
add_library(fvm_ffmpeg INTERFACE)
# Preserve dependency order for ordinary static Unix linkers.
foreach(component avdevice avformat avcodec swresample swscale avutil)
  set(archive "${FVM_FFMPEG_ROOT}/lib/${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_PREFIX}${component}${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}")
  if(NOT EXISTS "${archive}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing static FFmpeg component: ${archive}")
  endif()
  add_library(fvm_ffmpeg_${component} STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
  set_target_properties(fvm_ffmpeg_${component} PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${archive}")
  target_link_libraries(fvm_ffmpeg INTERFACE fvm_ffmpeg_${component})
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(fvm_ffmpeg INTERFACE ${FVM_FFMPEG_SYSTEM_LIBRARIES} ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
if(NOT WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(fvm_ffmpeg INTERFACE Threads::Threads m)
endif()
